expectations_gap.gap_narrative: At A$60, EV≈A$10.24bn → FY27 EV/Sales 3.09x / EV/EBITDA 12.8x. Even if Street’s 18.0% FY28 growth delivers, spot only capitalises a ~2.9x FY28 exit multiple (EV carried at WACC) — i.e. the market prices PERMANENT Melio drag and Ro40 miss (~37%). Street fair exit ~5.0x and our bull ~5.8x on Ro40 restoration (41% / 45%) define the expectations GAP. BUY = close the gap via Melio BE timing + Ro40, not Motley-Fool 'buy the dip'.

melio_bridge.methodology: Melio = option-like cashflow path to H2 FY28 adj-EBITDA run-rate BE, then FY29 EV/Sales exit (EBITDA cross-check). Core Xero SaaS valued separately — BUY is not lazy 'buy the dip' on group multiples.
